mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_data_record (device_id, dox, ph, thw, collect_time_str, created_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{dox}, #{ph}, #{thw}, #{collectTimeStr}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, dox, ph, thw, collect_time_str, created_at FROM device_data_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY collect_time_str DESC LIMIT 1
